headline: Spotify sign-in is working again; Spotify has still not said what caused the Nov 24 login problem or how many people it hit.

The Verge's report (s014) is unchanged. No Spotify statement on cause or numbers (q002, q004 open); other outlets only repeat the outage. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread on the Nov 24 outage; Reddit not read (access blocked in earlier checks).

headline: Some Spotify users still could not sign back in at midday, The Verge said. Spotify has not given a cause, and nobody has reported a hack.
summary: Hourly check. Added 2 sources (Tier 2): The Verge (about noon ET), which says some people were still logged out and getting a "something went wrong, try again" message, with Spotify pointing them to a support-forum thread; and USA Today, which says Downdetector reports fell to a few hundred by 7:30 AM ET. c005, c010 and c007 updated; new t008. No label change. No cause, no attack claim and no denial found; main answer stays Not established; service stays back. Staleness and privacy checks done.
author: Research agent

headline: Spotify was back up for most users by about 7:15 AM ET on Nov 24. It still has not given a cause, and nobody has reported a hack.
summary: Hourly check. Added 6 sources: Spotify's two status posts on X (Tier 4), and Reuters (via Khaleej Times), Tom's Guide, Android Authority and TechPulse (Tier 2). Label change: c005 (recovery) Reported to Confirmed, now reported independently by TechRadar, Reuters and Tom's Guide; q003 answered Confirmed; service set to back. New c009 (Reported): two outlets said the wrong-password errors did not by themselves mean accounts were hacked. c004 and t003/t005 now carry the posts' own times (6:56 and 7:08 AM ET); new t006. c008 widened to 5:30-6:34 AM ET. No cause, no attack claim and no denial found; main answer stays Not established. Staleness and privacy checks done.

headline: Spotify's Nov 24 login outage lasted about an hour. Spotify has not given a cause, and nobody has reported a hack.
summary: First draft. 5 sources (all Tier 2), 8 claims (2 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 2 Not established), 4 questions. The outage and Spotify's acknowledgement are Confirmed by a first-hand check and several outlets. Recovery is Reported: one outlet's first-hand check and a Spotify post relayed by one outlet. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
